WITH total_2024 AS (
    SELECT SUM("Loan Amount (Rs)") AS total
    FROM "shg_loan_register"
    WHERE "Disbursement Date" LIKE '2024%'
)
SELECT 
    "Purpose",
    SUM("Loan Amount (Rs)") AS total_amount,
    (SUM("Loan Amount (Rs)") * 100.0 / NULLIF(total_2024.total, 0)) AS percentage_share
FROM "shg_loan_register"
CROSS JOIN total_2024
WHERE "Disbursement Date" LIKE '2024%'
GROUP BY "Purpose"
ORDER BY total_amount DESC;
